faqs.question: How much does a website cost?
faqs.answer: The project cost depends on the website type, required features, design complexity, and overall requirements. Contact me with your project details for a customized quote.

faqs.question: How long does a website project take?
faqs.answer: The timeline depends on the complexity of the project. Simple websites can be completed faster, while advanced web applications may require additional development and testing time.

faqs.question: Do you provide website maintenance and support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Website maintenance, updates, optimization, and ongoing support can be provided based on your project requirements.

faqs.question: Can I update my website myself?
faqs.answer: Yes. For CMS-based websites such as WordPress, you can easily manage content and products. Guidance can also be provided after project delivery.

faqs.question: Do you provide hosting and domain support?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can help with domain setup, hosting configuration, website deployment, SSL, and other essential technical setup.

faqs.question: How can I start a project with you?
faqs.answer: Simply contact me with your project idea and requirements. We can discuss the details, features, timeline, and the best solution for your business.
